color.note: Brand hexes are sampled from the Concept 4 (Orange Edition) logo board, which the client chose over the guidelines doc's hexes (#102A43 / #FF5B22 / #FF8C42 / #FFC107 / #F8F9FA). Tokens marked 'derived' are not in the brand files.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Midnight Blue, the trust base. The 'Trips' wordmark, the T stroke, headers, dark backgrounds. Guidelines doc lists #102A43 (not used).

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Tangerine Orange — the LOGO colour, kept exact: the 'Enjoy' wordmark, the 'e', the middle dot, app-icon grounds. Not for UI text (2.64:1 on cream) — UI uses `primary` for fills and `primary-text` for orange text.

tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: Sunset Coral, the secondary accent. Gradients with brand-orange, badges, active states.

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Golden Amber, the warm highlight. Notifications, status badges, the smallest togetherness dot. Text on it is brand-navy (6.16:1).

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: Warm cream / off-white. App background and the logo board ground. Guidelines doc lists #F8F9FA (not used).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card containers on brand-cream; the reversed (white) logo and photo watermark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: cream. Dark: Midnight Blue, as the guidelines use it for dark backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs on surface. Dark value is derived (a lighter step of brand-navy).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Contrast panels and the app-icon ground: headers, footers, the navy slab on the cover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Light 11.72:1 / 13.05:1; dark 11.72:1 / 9.72:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Derived. Light 5.5:1 / 6.13:1; dark 6.85:1 / 5.69:1.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Derived. Not for control borders, and never a text ground for ink-muted (4.23:1 in dark) — use ink on it.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill (Book trip, Pay, Track bus). One per view. A near-identical UI step of brand-orange (#FF6527) so the navy label passes AA at every size: 4.62:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary: 4.62:1 at every size and weight. White on orange (≈2.9:1) fails — never use it.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and small orange icons in the UI (links, highlighted prices, 'Enjoy' set as live text) on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Same hue as the logo orange. Light 4.61:1 / 5.14:1; dark 5.46:1 / 4.53:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Active tabs, selected chips, badges, the far end of a primary gradient. Text on it is brand-navy (5.11:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Notification dots and status badges. Text on it is brand-navy.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline. 11.72:1 on cream (light), 6.16:1 on navy (dark).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input and chip borders. Derived. 3.87:1 on white, 3.5:1 on cream (light); 3.7:1 on raised, 4.5:1 on navy (dark) — meets the 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: PROPOSED status colour (not in the brand files). Error text, invalid inputs, 'not boarded' and low seats on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-soft`. Light 5.9:1 / 6.57:1 / 5.59:1; dark 6.42:1 / 5.33:1 / 6.44:1. Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (6.5:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Background of danger badges; danger text on it 5.56:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: PROPOSED status colour. 'Boarded', 'Arrived' and confirmed-payment text on `surface-raised` and `success-soft`. Light 5.32:1 / 4.63:1; dark 6.09:1 / 6.38:1. Told apart from danger by lightness and always by icon + word, not hue alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Background of success badges; success text on it 4.67:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: PROPOSED status colour. Warning titles, icons and text (delays, expiring holds, retrying) on `warning-soft` and `surface-raised`. Light 6.09:1 / 6.8:1; dark 6.98:1 / 6.89:1. Pair with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Background of warning alerts and the web RetryBanner.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info alerts and the Organization role badge; text on it is ink (10.7:1 light, 8.46:1 dark).

tokens.name: map-ground
tokens.usage: Land fill of the LiveBusMap illustration. Derived.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Roads and stop fills in the LiveBusMap. Derived.

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: The trip route line and stop rings in the LiveBusMap; the bus marker is primary.

tokens.name: glass-fill-regular
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass — Regular variant fill for bars, tab bars and floating controls. Keeps ink ≥ 4.5:1 over worst-case content (dark fill raised to 0.75 so cream ink holds over white photos).

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass — Clear variant fill. A see-through background layer, not a text colour: use it only over photos and maps, with the glass-dim scrim beneath. Labels over Clear glass are pure #FFFFFF.

tokens.name: glass-dim
tokens.usage: Dimming scrim placed over media under Clear glass so white text stays legible.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge of glass shapes.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Specular top-edge highlight of glass.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Top sheen of the glass lensing gradient.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass for the ONE primary floating action (e.g. Track bus): an opaque primary fill that keeps the glass edge, sheen and shadow, so the navy label holds 4.62:1 over any content.

tokens.name: glass-selection
tokens.usage: Selected tab pill inside a glass tab bar.

tokens.name: tab-active
tokens.usage: Icon and label of the active tab on glass.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline on landing pages. One per page.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, trip names in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Parents see which bus their child is on, live.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic hero headline and the Arabic name.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Arabic body copy. Medium per the guidelines; taller leading than English.

spacing.note: Derived 4px scale; the brand files define no spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on web, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections on web.

radius.note: Rounded, friendly shapes as in the mark and the rounded-square app icon. Values derived.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, hero cards, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App-icon rounded square, as on the logo board.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, status badges, the togetherness dots.

shadow.note: Soft navy-tinted shadows; glass shadow lifts the controls layer above content.

tokens.name: card-shadow
tokens.usage: TripCard and raised cards.

tokens.name: card-shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered clickable card.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Every Liquid Glass surface.

blur.note: Backdrop filter amounts for Liquid Glass.

tokens.name: glass-blur-regular
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur of Regular glass.

tokens.name: glass-blur-clear
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur of Clear glass.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter saturate on all glass — lets content colour glow through.
